name: remove-deprecated-kody-engine
body:
When a package is deprecated (like @kody-ade/engine) but a newer replacement (@kody-ade/kody-engine) is already in use, remove the deprecated package from dependencies. This prevents transitive dependency conflicts.

Why: @kody-ade/engine was pinning @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to 1.27.1 even though the project had ^1.29.0 as a direct dependency. Removing the deprecated package allowed proper semver resolution.

How to apply: When updating dependencies and seeing unexpected version downgrades, check if deprecated packages are causing transitive dependency conflicts.

name: pnpm-overrides-match-direct-deps
hook: Keep pnpm overrides aligned with actual dependency version requirements
body:
pnpm overrides can force a package version independently of semver ranges. When you update a direct dependency's version range, update or remove corresponding overrides to avoid conflicts.

Why: An override of '>=1.25.2' was conflicting with a direct dependency of '^1.29.0', causing pnpm to resolve to 1.27.1 instead of 1.29.0.

How to apply: After changing a direct dependency version, check if there's a matching pnpm override that might interfere.
